transcript.text: Hey Bilal... working late tonight, huh? Everything good?

Ah, my mistake! You want a spot in Casa for free. Honestly, for free, that's tough. Your best bet is probably self-study online... or, you know, you've got me right here for practice. What do you think?
Maybe just rearranging your room could help? Or going to a quiet cafe sometimes, even if it's not for free, just for that change of scenery. Do any of those sound doable?
Fair enough, cafes can get pricey. What about parks or even just sitting outside somewhere when the weather is nice? Could that be a little change of pace?
Alright, new things it is! Looks like you've got your German alphabet notes there. I also see that nice wooden table you're working on—that's 'der Tisch' in German. Are you practicing pronunciation?

My bad! Right now I see the close-up of your notebook with the alphabet written out. Looks like you've even got pronunciation notes there, like 'beh' for 'B'... and I can see you've drawn a box for the 'Umlaute'. So, which letter are you working on?
